name: Montenegro

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 623327 inhabitants, recorded as 0.623 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Still an opening estimate, and this note exists so the next pass does not start from nothing. Researched on 2026-07-27 in the transversal venues pass and left unchanged, because what was established and what was not fall on either side of the value. Established, on the Capital City's own page listing its public institutions: JU Gradsko pozorište in Podgorica, Bokeška 2, is a javna ustanova of Podgorica, so a public institution with a venue. Not established: that it holds a permanent puppetry unit. Every account of a puppet stage and of a drama stage for children comes from second-hand summaries, and the theatre's own site answered 503 on every attempt through the day, as did the site of the Podgorica international puppetry festival. Under the rule of this repository a summary is not a source, so the value stays where it was rather than moving on a reading that was never made. The likely answer is 1, a stage inside a larger organisation; it is not recorded because likely is not read.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The Faculty of Dramatic Arts in Cetinje, a unit of the state University of Montenegro and autonomous since 1997, offers acting, theatre and screen directing, production and dramaturgy at undergraduate and specialist level. No puppetry programme. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the detailed curriculum not having been read. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.

venues: re-read pgpozoriste.me when it answers. The question is narrow — does JU Gradsko pozorište name a permanent lutkarska scena, and does it hold puppeteers? The public status and the address are already established from podgorica.me. If the puppet stage is confirmed the value becomes 1, unit stage, parent JU Gradsko pozorište, at Bokeška 2.
